verdict.rationale: Self-hosting and pipeline control are fair questions for an email product, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Gmail as a Google-hosted service. IMAP/POP/SMTP access for third-party clients and Workspace custom-domain email are adjacent features that leave the mail servers under Google's control, so they earn no credit. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hostable Gmail deployment.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
